entries.notes: Live client: src/data/nasa/donki.ts reads https://api.nasa.gov/DONKI/SEP (windows of 60 days or less; DEMO_KEY rate limit handled). Offline: built-in snapshot src/data/nasa/donki-snapshot.json, refreshed with pnpm data:donki. 2026 migration notice: CCMC announced a new API base /DONKI-API/get/... for 2026-09-30; that host did not answer from the team network on 2026-11-15 while api.nasa.gov did. re-verify both hosts before changing the endpoint.
